title: feat(CE-17): directory search API with location + specialty filters
body:
## Summary

Replaces the in-memory JS filtering in the directory search with fully DB-backed, composable Supabase queries. Adds `specialty`, `city`, `state` as optional query params to all three search endpoints (`/api/directory`, `/api/organizations`, `/api/providers`).

**Schema** — additive migration adds `city`, `state`, `zip`, `specialties text[]` to `organizations`. `specialties` covers the "org accepts referrals for X specialty" case (e.g. all rheum referrals to Mayo WI intake).

**Filter mapping:**
- `specialty` → `organizations.specialties` (array contains) + `providers.specialty` (ilike)
- `city`/`state` → `organizations.city/state` (ilike); providers filtered via org-location subquery
- `q` → ilike on name/slug (orgs) and name/npi/specialty (providers)

All params optional; omitting = no filter on that dimension. No-params path returns all active rows (regression-safe).

**Seed** — expanded to 9 orgs across MN, WI, MA, OH, MD, CA with realistic specialties. Includes WI cardiology (Mayo WI, Froedtert, Aurora) + providers so `?specialty=cardiology&state=WI` returns meaningful data for CE-10 MCP demo.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/80a1bfe5042f48d59e36b256fa86c0a2
